description.value: You can swear a soul-sworn oath with one other willing sapient creature, empathically bonding your souls to one another. Swearing this bond is a 10-minute activity that you must both participate in. A soul-sworn oath lasts until you or the target choose to end it as a free action. You can only have one soul-sworn oath active at a time. If you attempt to swear a second soul-sworn oath, the first soul-sworn oath immediately ends. You and the target of this oath can communicate with each other mentally, as if you had limited telepathy with a range of 60 feet. In addition, as long as you can communicate mentally with one another, you share each other's languages.
